name: Train Window
desc: The view from a moving train window — three-speed parallax with drifting clouds and a low sun, rolling far hills, scrolling mid-ground trees or dunes or containers, rushing foreground speed streaks and telephone poles whipping past, all framed by a rounded dark window with optional rain streaks and droplets plus a faint interior reflection. Styles: green countryside, night ride, desert, coastal sailboats, industrial yards.
